<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring" name="Credit scoring collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest"
                      name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRequest"
                      targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice"
                      name="Delay notice"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"
                      targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult"
                      name="Immediate scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult"
                      targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result"
                      name="Level 2 scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"
                      targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking system credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Banking">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesClerk" name="Sales clerk">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestScoring</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowDelayNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ShowResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Banking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchDelayNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CatchLevel2Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeResults</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Banking</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Banking" name="Credit scoring requested"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestScoring" name="Request credit scoring via frontend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelayNotice" name="Receive delay notice">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ShowDelayNotice" name="Display message to check again later"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeResults" name="Merge scoring result paths"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ShowResult" name="Display scoring result at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Banking" name="Scoring result displayed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_Banking" targetRef="Task_RequestScoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_RequestScoring" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_ShowDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_ShowDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeResults" targetRef="Task_ShowResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_11" sourceRef="Task_ShowResult" targetRef="End_Banking"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateResult" name="Is the result determined immediately?" default="Flow_Agency_Delayed"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyImmediate" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring (up to a couple of minutes)"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result to banking system" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyLevel2" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Immediate" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">immediateResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_ImmediateEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_AgencyImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Delayed" name="Result not determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_AgencyLevel2"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
